workbench.catalogHint: Find an element — its parameters open as soon as you choose it.
workbench.startTitle: What should happen in your mission?
workbench.startBody: Create a trigger or select an element on the left. Configure its condition and all its actions together here.
workbench.outlineHint: Add a condition and an action. Mission settings and individual commands are available in the catalogue.
workbench.viewOnly: Only the list view changes. Execution order stays the same.
builder.help: Scenario elements are on the left; the wide editor is on the right. New trigger opens its condition and actions side by side. Add action opens a searchable, grouped catalogue. Command catalogue on the toolbar includes all settings and commands. Click Add trigger or Apply changes, then save the file. Global search finds scenario elements; the catalogue count opens matching commands. Additional file commands are in More.
description.7: Read the chosen parameter for selected players. Pick their colours and optionally include Neutral or Local.
